verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 is infrastructure that hosts users' own AI agents in isolated cloud sandboxes, and it can serve as a backend for third-party agent frameworks such as the OpenAI Agents SDK and LangChain Deep Agents. Nothing in the evidence shows a built-in first-party AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. A managed platform like this could plausibly ship one, so the axis applies, but hosting or integrating external agents does not count as a built-in assistant.
